mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu ! O great compassionate one! Ciri ciri , miri miri , curu curu ! O great compassionate one! Siri siri , ciri ciri , piri piri , viri viri ! O great one with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu ! O great pure being! Awaken, awaken! Cleanse, cleanse! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu ! O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru ! You who attained great fortitude! Cala cala , saṃcala saṃcala , vicala vicala , eṭṭaṭṭa eṭṭaṭṭa , bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru ! Come, come, O great compassionate one! You who wear the garb of great Paśupati! Wear, wear! Sara sara , cara cara , hara hara , hāhā hāhā , hīhī hīhī , hūhū hūhū ! You who wear the garb of Brahmā, the syllable oṁ ! Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , tara tara , sara sara , para para , cara cara ! You with the body adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays! Shine, shine! Heat up, heat up! O blessed sun and moon! You whose feet are worshiped by the hosts of ṛṣis and gods, by Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Great Indra! Suru suru , curu curu , muru muru , puru puru ! You who wear many various garbs of ṛṣis and gods, of Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, and Dhanada! Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara , hara hara , mara mara , para para , vara vara ! O boon giver who sees all around you! O great lord of the world who perceives precisely! Muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya ! Save beings, save! You are the lord Noble Avalokiteśvara! Protect, protect me and all beings in the three worlds from every danger, every misfortune, every calamity, and from all grahas! O savior from bondage, imprisonment, beatings, threats, the king, thieves, robbers, fire, water, poison, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , cara cara ! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Scorch, scorch! Tame, tame! Pacify, pacify! Masa masa ! O great being! Dispeller of darkness! Fulfiller of the six perfections! Mili mili , ṭaṭa ṭaṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu ! You who wear a tunic of antelope skin! Come, come! You are the great lord who crushes the hordes of bhūtas! Act, act! Para para , kara kara , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You abide in the pure domain, O great compassionate one! You wear a white sacred thread and a diadem with a row of jewels—the diadem of omniscience atop your head. The palms of your hands are adorned with marvelous lotuses. Your meditative concentration, samādhi, and liberation are unshakable. You mature the mindstreams of many beings completely. O great compassionate one! Purifier of all karmic obscurations! Deliverer from all illness! Fulfiller of all wishes! Comforter of all beings! Homage be to you! Svāhā .
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ cara cara ciri ciri curu curu mahākāruṇika .
Skt. ciri ciri miri miri curu curu mahākāruṇika .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with a lotus in your hand, great Amoghapāśa, activate the essence of samaya! Go ahead, do! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmahasta mahāmoghapāśa sādhaya samaya hṛdayaṃ cara cara hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O lotus holder who grants unfailing victory! Curu curu , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmadhara amogha jayade curu curu svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O holder of a lotus noose who grants amogha boons! Arouse the buddhas, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmapāśadhara amogha varada sañcodaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O lotus-eyed Amoghapāśa! Traverse the three worlds and come to the earth! Suru suru suru ! O pure being, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ trailokyavāhaya amogha pāśa padmavilokita āyāntu bhuvane suru suru suru vimale hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O lotus-armed one who holds the great noose! I invite you, one of unfailing power, to come to Earth! Muru muru , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmabhuja mahāpāśadhara nimantrayāmi amogha balāyāntu bhuvasva muru muru hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Padmāmogha, get on, get on with vajra-securing the ground! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: It is not clear whether padmāmogha in this mantra is an independent word or compounded with vajrādhiṣṭhānena . If it is meant to be independent, it could be (as this translation assumes) one of the many epithets of Amoghapāśa.
Skt. oṁ padmāmogha vajrādhiṣṭhānena kuru kuru svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the throne of Amoghapāśa upon lotuses! Oṭi , miri miri , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha pāśa padmottara siṃhāsana oṭi miri miri hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , great compassionate Amoghapāśa! You are founded upon a firm vajra! Bhuru bhuru , in this best of places, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ mahākaruṇāmoghapāśa dṛḍhavajrādhiṣṭhita bhuru bhuru bhuvanavare svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , secure the border surrounding the ten directions with the unfailing lotus rope! Turu turu , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmāmoghapāśena samantād daśasu dikṣu sīmā bandhaya turu turu hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha maṇḍala! Secure the borders all around with lotuses and great lotuses! Dhuru dhuru , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha maṇḍala bandhaya samante padmamahāpadme dhuru dhuru svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha purity! Purify the entire area! Dhiri dhiri ! O pure being! O great lotus! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha pariśuddhe śodhaya samantena dhiri dhiri śuddhasattva mahāpadme hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , flow within the lotus, flow! Remain, remain! O great amogha samaya! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padme sara sara tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahāmogha samaya svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , great lotus, amogha-expand! May he enter! Act, act, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vipulapadmāmoghaprasara praviśatu kuru kuru svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha-settle within the circumference of the great lotus, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: “Amogha” could be an adverb here qualifying “settle,” with the meaning “please settle the amogha way.”
Skt. oṁ amogha anuśaya mahāpadmabandhure hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha lotus in the topknot! Turu turu ! Remain in the vajra knot, svāhā !
criticalNotes: “Amogha lotus” ( amoghapadma ) could also be an epithet of Amoghapāśa.
Skt. oṁ amogha padmaśikhe turu turu tiṣṭha vajra bandhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , toss the lotus water of Amogha ! Bhiri bhiri , hūṃ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha padmajalotkṣepa bhiri bhiri hūṃ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha deformed water-container on a lotus seat! Full of water! Act, act, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: The phrase amogha vikaṭasambhara is difficult to unravel.
Skt. oṁ amogha vikaṭasambhara padmāsane jalavati kuru kuru hūṃ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha purity within the expanse of the lotus! Carry, carry, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmaprasare amogha vimale bhara bhara svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha lotus, the auspicious pure lotus that brings fulfillment! Viri viri , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Again, “amogha lotus” ( amoghapadma ) could be an epithet of Amoghapāśa.
Skt. oṁ amogha padme supadme pūrṇakare viri viri vimale svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha purity that purifies the tip of the tongue! Tender as lotus, please purify the tongue! Keep it so, keep! Auspicious purity, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vimale jihvāgraṃ saṃśodhani padmakomalajihvā saṃśodhaya dhara dhara suvimale svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , fragrant Amogha ! Suru suru , prabhuru ! Divine fragrance with the glow of a lotus! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha gandhavati suru suru prabhuru divyagandhiḥ padmaprabhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: phaṭ
Oṁ , free from impurities in the inner space of the lotus! Roam through and merge with the sky, hūṁ ! Amogha-accomplished! Purify, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ malavigate padmavivare sañcara cacare svari hūṁ | amogha siddhe śodhaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with amogha lotus eyes and divine vision, completely pure! Suru suru ! O lotus-eyed one, bhuru bhuru ! You direct your gaze everywhere! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha padmalocani divyadṛṣṭi pariśuddhe suru suru padmākṣi bhuru bhuru samantavyavalokani svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , wake up, wake up! Wake up lucidly, facing Padmāmogha! Choose, choose any boon! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Again, it is impossible to interpret the mantric phrases definitively. Padmāmoghamukhin could mean “facing ( mukhin ) Padmāmogha” (Padmāmogha being an epithet of Amoghapāśa), or it could be translated as “[you] with the amogha lotus face.”

The translation of the Sanskrit vara as “choose” is arbitrary, as this word has other meanings that could also fit the context of this mantra, such as “best.” This sentence could then be translated as “You are the best, the best among the best.”

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , holder of the amogha treasury! Unfold, expand, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha kośadhara sara prasara hūṁ . In place of ˚ kośa ˚, the Tibetan reads ˚ dhara ˚, which would change the translation of the mantra to “ Oṁ , holder of the unfailing noose! Unfold, expand, hūṁ !”

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha garments! Muru muri ! Become divinely soft! Tara tara , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha prāvaraṇa muru muri divyakaśikaṃ sambhavatu tara tara svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha clothes! I cast off clothes within the lotus that brings awakening, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vastrāṇy utkṣipāmi bodhini padme svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , collecting the rainwater, you flow along the amogha banks! Consecrate! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Reading varaṇa as dharaṇa (“dyke/bank”).
Skt. oṁ divyodakasaṃbhūtāmoghavaraṇacare ’bhiṣiñcya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha lotus seat of nectar, raining down! Curu curu , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amṛtāmoghapadmāsane varṣaṇi curu curu svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha protection! Take effect, do!
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha rakṣiṇi kuru kuru svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha samaya! Remain within the great lotus, hūṃ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha samaya mahāpadme tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūṃ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you who never fail in any way! Remain and protect, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvvatra amoghavati tiṣṭha rakṣatu hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you who overstep the three worlds with amogha lotus steps! Mili mili , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ trailokya padmāmoghakramiṇi mili mili svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , unfold within the lotus, the great lotus! Surround everything with the unfailing noose! Huru huru , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padme mahāpadme sara sara samantena pariveṣṭayāmoghapāśena huru huru svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , bright multicolored amogha cloth! Effect purification! kiṇi kiṇi , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: The page marker here reads [A.10.a] instead of the expected [A.9.b] because of the omission of an interpolated passage that is repeated later on, from A.16.b.4 to A.17.a.2 , where it contextually belongs.
Skt. oṁ vicitrāmoghavastra nānāraṅga viśuddhaya kiṇi kiṇi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , diamond-tipped amogha arrow! Thara thara , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha śara vajra tuṇḍa thara thara svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the great, completely pure, broad amogha gate! Siri siri , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vipulāmoghamahādvāraviśuddhe siri siri svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you are filled and surrounded with various splendid amogha flowers and fruits! Para para , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ nānāvicitra• amogha puṣpaphalatākīrṇapūrṇa para para hūṃ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , jewel amogha palace, consecrated with the sacrificial vessel, you are divinely fragrant and radiating light everywhere! Shine, shine, svāhā !
criticalNotes: It is not clear what kind of vessel it is. Kaṭaccha normally means “ladle,” but the context seems to indicate that itis a vessel for holding incense or a censer.
Skt. oṁ amogha ratnavimāna kaṭacchādhiṣṭhita divyagandhojjvalaspharaṇa samantena jvala jvala svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , shining water jar, you cause the flow! Tuṭi tuṭi , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ jvalavati ratnaghaṭa sāriṇi tuṭi tuṭi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine vessel! Supreme amogha lotus! Fill up, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyabhājana amogha padmavare pūraya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the scented amogha basin that fills to the brim! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha saṃpūraṇidroṇagandhavati svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , flowing stream! O amogha dish, release the stream! Intoxicator, intoxicate! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ saraṇi sāraya amogha bhājane mada mādani hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine one with the jewel vase! You fill the oceans, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyaratnakumbhavati sāgara saṃpūraṇi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , brightly blazing with different colors! Make the divisions distinct! Purify! Tuṭi , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vicitrojjvala nānāraṅga vibhaktaya saṃśodhaya tuṭi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , gazing vidyā! Divide the entire area! Stretch forth! Stretch symmetrically, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Depending on the spelling variants ( sama or śama ), this phrase could be translated in several different ways, such as “oasis of peace” ( śamasaraṇe ), etc.
Skt. oṁ vidyāvalokini vibhajayatu samantena sara samasaraṇe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the various implements that constitute amogha emblems! Blaze, blaze, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ nānāpraharaṇa• amogha mudrā jvala jvala svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , supreme amogha jewel thread! Kiṇi kiṇi , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha ratnasūtravare kiṇi kiṇi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , cause them to enter the supreme, wide amogha lotus, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vipulavare praveśaya amogha padme hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine dish, the supreme golden amogha dish! Giri giri , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyabhājanāmoghakāñcanavare giri giri hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine silver dish, fully filled! O amogha lotus, svāha !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sampūrṇarūpyadivyabhājane ’moghapadme svāha .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , oblatory foods and implements! Move, move! You are not subject to failure, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vividharūpopahāropakaraṇa cala cala amoghavati svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you serve with divine fragrances! Amogha power! Hold, hold, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyagandhānusāriṇi amogha bale dhara dhara svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you spread fragrance! Amogha-spread it everywhere, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ gandhaspharaṇi samantāmogha prasphura hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you purify the body, making it immaculate! You fill it with divine fragrance! Fill it, fill, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ nirmalakāyaśodhani divyagandhaprapūraṇi pūraya pūraya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you provide the full measure of scented powders! Curu curu , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ gandhacūrṇaprapūraṇi curu curu svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , supreme pure fragrance that evenly spreads everywhere! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ samasamantena vimale gandhottare svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you provide the full measure of divine fragrance! Divinely consecrated as the water of the ocean, you fill the interior of the water pitcher! Fill it, O bringer of victory, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyagandhaprapūraṇi sāgara jaladivyādhiṣṭhite kalaśodaripūrṇa pūraya jayasiddhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you possess the most exquisite of flavors! Blessed by all the vidyās! Become complete, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ rasarasāgravati sarvvavidyādhiṣṭhita saṃpūraya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine food of great splendor! Fill the stomach, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyabhojana saṃpūraya vipulaprabhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the three “white” foods! Bali with a broad range of exquisite tastes! Sura prasura , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ triśuklabhojana balivipularasāgravati sura prasura hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine tree of the forest, rich in fruit and sap! Tara tara , tuni , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ phalavati sāravati divyavanaspati tara tara tuni svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you rain down various flowers such as celestial water lilies! Stay on, stay! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyakusumotpalanānāpuṣpapravarṣaṇi bhava bhava svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , forest tree overhung with various vines and flowers! Jar filled with food! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: There may be some corruption here, as the second phrase in this mantra does not seem to belong with the first, or, possibly, the vines and flowers are meant to decorate the “jar filled with food.”
Skt. oṁ vividhalatāpuṣpāvaguṇṭhitavanaspati āhārasaṃpūrṇṇakumbhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , great cloud of incense! Envelope everything around! Hūṁ hūṁ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ mahādhūpameghapaṭala saṃcchādaya samantena hūṁ hūṁ svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , magical being! Blaze, blaze! You are the face of the gods! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ atharvaṇi jvala jvala deva mukhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , various jewels! Shining adornments of gold and precious stone! Jewel, jewel, amogha jewel! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vividhamaṇi kanakaratnojjvalabhūṣaṇa maṇi maṇi amogha maṇi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ oṁ , lotus hands! Sama sama ! Fingers with broad fingernails! Blessed by all the tathāgatas! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ oṁ padmakare vipulanakhāṅguli sama sama sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhite svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , bowing my head, I pay homage to the perfect one with all the qualities! Mili mili , turiṇi , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvaguṇāpratihataśirovandanayā namaskaromi mili mili turiṇi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , may my homage extend through the ten directions! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ daśadiśābhivandanaprasaratu hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , hand, you are ablaze with various implements! Blaze forth, shine, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vividhāyudhajvalitapāṇi prajvala sphura hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the divine amogha sound that spreads far and wide! You with a sweet tone! Ring, ring, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyāmoghavipulasvare madhuranighoṣarute raṇa raṇa hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the great jewel-like flame! Illuminate everything around with your bright light, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ raśmijvālasamantenāvabhāsaya mahāmaṇiratnaśikhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , dhuru dhuru ! Bring over! O speedy one, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ dhuru dhuru āvāhaya śīghrajave hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you bring realization to wicked beings! Sama , holder of the samaya, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Possibly, sama was added before samaya ( sama samaya ˚) for the sake of alliteration and rhythm, as is common in mantras.
Skt. oṁ duṣṭasattvavibodhani sama samaya dhare svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , bright jewels, turned many times, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vicitramaṇi vipulapravartani hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you are made of divine flowers that blaze with colors like jewels! O flower delight, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vicitraratnojjvaladivyakusumadhare puṣparati svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine, unfailing eye! Supreme and perfect! Blessed by all the vidyās! Your perception is pure, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ divyalocane amoghe pravare sarvavidyādhiṣṭhitasiddhe śuddhavilokite svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha lotus, you are an all-encompassing residence! Tara tara ! Depart to your homes, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha padme samantabhuvane tara tara gacchasva bhavanaṃ svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , divine fulfiller with an elephant’s gaze, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: “Elephant’s gaze” is a type of gazing. For example, the Buddha gazed at the city of Vaiśālī before he died with an “elephant’s gaze.” It is not clear though how this relates to the monk’s staff.
Skt. oṁ divyasaṃpūraṇi nāga vilokani hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , filler of the alms bowl! Fill it up! You with a radiating halo who never fails, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ pātrapūraṇi pūraya amogha vati samantaprabhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the bed of darbha grass blessed by the vidyās! Spread! Sura sura ! You are worshiped by sages, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ darbharasaṃstara vidyādhiṣṭhita prasara sura sura ṛṣi pūjite svāhā (after emending durbha ˚ to darbha ˚).

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , fire and smoke! Blazing flames! Impregnated with light! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ jvaladhūmajvālaśikhiraśmigarbhe svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the most exquisite place and the abode of lotuses! The dwelling place of the nāgas, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmini padmāsane varapravare nāga bhuvane svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , sky traveler! Move and make move! You make the feet move, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ khacāriṇi gama gamaya pādapracāriṇi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the pure, universal amogha empowerment applied to the top of the head! O holder of a lotus banner with fine arms and hands, consecrate me, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvatrāmoghābhiṣekamahācūḍāvimale abhiṣiñcantu māṃ pravarapāṇibhuje padmadhvaje svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , homage to you with a miraculous panoptic amogha vision! O amogha lotus of the tathāgatas who are established throughout the three times! Be active, diffuse, and unite, hūṁ hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vikurvitasamantāvalokāya namas | tryadhvādhiṣṭhitā · amogha padme cara vicara sañcara hūṁ hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha lotus-goad! Catch, catch the samaya! Hold it, hold! O great being, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: “Amogha lotus-goad” ( amogha padmāṅkuśa ) should be interpreted here in the literal sense of a goad or hook that catches and holds the samaya, and also as the name of the deity Amoghapadmāṅkuśa.
Skt. oṁ amogha padmāṅkuśa samayaṃ gṛhna gṛhna dhara dhara mahāsattva hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghapadma, the great being! Please come into this maṇḍala! Ciri ciri ciri ! You with the lotus in your hand, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha padma mahāsattva āyātu-m-iha maṇḍale ciri ciri ciri padmabhuje svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , great boundary, formed around [this place] as the diamond-hard amogha lotus! Protect me! Curu curu , hūṁ phaṭ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vajra dṛḍhapadmabandha samantena mahāsīmā rakṣantu māṃ curu curu hūṁ phaṭ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , vajra! Vajra-blessed lotus that assumes the universal form! Assume, assume it, hūṁ ! Enter the course of the three times! Dhiri tuṭi , svāhā !
criticalNotes: In the iconography of the lotus, “universal” form implies a multicolored double lotus.
Skt. oṁ vajre vajrādhiṣṭhitapadme viśvarūpadhare dhara dhara hūṁ praviśatu tryadhvagatāṃ dhiri tuṭi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the water of amogha lotus, purify, hūṃ ! Viri viri , O pure one, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha padmajale viśodhaya hūṃ viri viri vimale svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha lotus lord, firm as diamond! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vajra dṛḍha padmeśvara hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus lord! Conferrer of amogha boons! Bhiri bhiri , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmeśvara amogha varada bhiri bhiri svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , turu turu ! The lotus-related amogha accomplishment, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ turu turu padme amogha siddhiṃ hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the lotus with an amogha heart essence! Hold it, hold, O lotus holder! The essence of the great maṇḍala, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha hṛdayapadme dhara dhara padmadhara mahā maṇḍala hṛdaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O noose-holding lord of unfree beings, with a body adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays! Pull them in! Awaken them, awaken them fully! Bhuru bhuru ! You are the master of the unfailing noose, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ paśupati pāśadharaḥ śatasahasraraśmipratimaṇḍitakāya ākarṣaṇi bodhani saṃbodhani bhuru bhuru amogha pāśasiddhe hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you who abide in the three times, consecrate me with all the consecrations of the three times! O jewel among lotuses! Auspicious amogha lotus, blessed by all the tathāgatas! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ tryadhvānugatābhiṣiñcatu sarvvatryadhvābhiṣekaiḥ padmamaṇi supadme amoghe sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhite hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Krodharāja, great and unfailing! Strike, strike all the villains, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ krodha rāja mahāmogha hana hana sarvvaduṣṭān hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus-like Tārā! Turu turu , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmatāre turu turu hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , great lotus-like, white-bodied goddess! Huru huru , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ mahāpadme śvetāṅge huru huru svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus-like Bhṛkuṭī! Tara tara , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ bhṛkuṭi padme tara tara hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus-like Pāṇḍaravāsinī! Kuṇḍa kuṇḍa , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padme pāṇḍaravāsini kuṇḍa kuṇḍa svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the giver of the boons of Amoghapadma! Succeed, succeed, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha padmavarade sidhya sidhyatu hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you visit everywhere! Bring them here, O fierce goddess! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvatra gāmini āvāhaya raudriṇi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghinī! Harlot! Deliver beings! O lotus-armed one, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amoghini vāre tāraya padmabhuje hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , dāru ! Fresh lotus! Amogha , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Reading tarula as taruṇa (the letters la and ṇa look similar in the Māgadhī script). The original tarula could mean “small tree,” which is also possible, as the preceding dāru means “tree.”
Skt. oṁ dārutarulapadme amogha hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Vaḍavāmukhā! Massacre the wicked, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vaḍavāmukhe nikṛndaya duṣṭā hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus-like Lord Nīlakaṇṭha! Bhuru bhuru , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padme nīlakaṇṭheśvara bhuru bhuru hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , fair-faced one! Be pleased! Pacify, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ saumyavadane prasīda śāsaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus goddess! Bring accomplishment, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmeśvari sādhaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , unerring goddess, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogheśvari hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Samarī! Ture ture , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ samari ture ture hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus goddess of the nāgas! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: The meaning of this phrase is unclear, but this mantra seems to be associated with the mudrā of Varuṇa (in the list of mudrās above), which was for controlling the nāgas.
Skt. oṁ nāga padmini hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , general of the yakṣas! Muru muru , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ yakṣādhipati muru muru hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amogha , you are Brahmā’s delight! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: The Skt. compound brahmārate could be translated in more than one way. If dissolved as brahma - a - rate , it could mean “unceasing as brahman” etc.
Skt. oṁ amoghe brahmārate hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha-armed, you grant the boons of the ṛṣis! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: This could be “of the ṛṣis” or “to the ṛṣis.”
Skt. oṁ riṣivarade amogha bhuje hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , King Amogha-Viṣṇu with a lotus growing out of your navel and arms surrounded by water! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha viṣṇu rājapadmanābhe sarasamantabhuje svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Rudra! Tuṭi mili , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ rudra tuṭi mili svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , unerring holder of a spear! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ śakti dhare amogha vati svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , thousand-rayed one, hūṁ ! Turi , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sahasrakiraṇe hūṁ turi svāhā .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the light of Soma! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ soma prabhe hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha añjali! Mili cili , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: This phrase could also be translated “the añjali of Amogha ,” “unfailing añjali,” etc.
Skt. oṁ amogha -m- añjali mili cili hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , please give comfort to those without freedom! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ āśvāsaya kṣaṇavigate hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , fearless boon giver! Tuṭi , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ abhayavarade tuṭi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , blessed by all the tathāgatas! Bhiri bhiri , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhite bhiri bhiri hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the lotus-essence fist! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmahṛdayamuṣṭi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , remove, remove all impurities! Threaten! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ visara visara sarvamalān tarjaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , blossom! Huru huru , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vijṛmbha huru huru hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , unfailing goad, pull! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ aṅkuśāmogha karṣaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , provide an armor! Turu turu , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ kavacaya turu turu hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha chain! Miri miri , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha saṃkalī miri miri hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , unfailing wish-fulfilling jewel! Tuṭi turu , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha cintāmaṇi tuṭi turu hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha jewel! Ciri ciri , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha maṇi ciri ciri hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , vajra! Tuṭi cili , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vajra tuṭi cili hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , essence of Amogha , be active, be! O pure being! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha hṛdaya cara cara śuddhasattva hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , resounding one! Viṭi viṭi , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ ghoṣavati viṭi viṭi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , sword of knowledge, crush the enemies! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vidyā khadga cchindaya śatruṃ hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you are free from the three stains! Bhiṭi bhiṭi , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ trimalapariśuddhe bhiṭi bhiṭi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , suru suru , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ suru suru hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , jewel, jewel! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ maṇi maṇi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the victory abounding in flowers! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ puṣpavati jaye hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you who hold the noose of compassion, hold it! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ bodhicittapāśadhara dhara hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the lotus noose, completely pure! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ padmapāśaviśuddhe hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the vajra noose, may you be so! Muru muru , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vajra pāśe bhavatu muru muru hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the noose that is like a wish-fulfilling jewel, the giver of boons! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ cintāmaṇipāśavarade hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the discus-noose, the crusher! Dhuru dhuru , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ cakrapāśāsuranirghātaka dhuru dhuru hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the trident noose! Watch over me and deliver me from suffering! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ triśūlīpāśa vilokaya tāraya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the noose that binds nāgas! Bind and pull them in! Bring down the wicked nāgas with your noose! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ nāga pāśa bandhayākaḍḍhaya duṣṭa nāga pāśa pātaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you who originate in the waters! Tear them, tear apart! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ jalodbhava dara dāraya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , pure as the moon! Dispel the darkness, O supreme light! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Reading (on the authority of the Tib. transliteration) raśmidhare as raśmivare .
Skt. oṁ candra vimale viśodhayāndhakāraṃ raśmivare hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , bring full awakening! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ prabodhaya hūṁ . The Tib. reads śrībodhaya in place of prabodhaya .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , full receptacle of victory! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vijayapūrṇadhare hūṁ . The Tib. reads ˚ pare in place of ˚ dhare .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , source of results! Turi , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ phalodbhave turi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , full disk of the moon, be victorious! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ pūrṇamaṇḍale jaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the thousand rays! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sahasraraśmikiraṇe hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , strike all the wicked ones! Discipline them! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvvaduṣṭān prahara śāsaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , remove impurities! You are immaculate and stainless! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ malaṃ viśodhayāmalavimale hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you are filled with flowers of the finest fragrance! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ puṣpavati sugandhavare hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with hundreds of thousands of qualities! Kṣaṇa kṣaṇa , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ śatasahasraguṇite kṣaṇa kṣaṇa hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , raised vajra with the sharp point! Ciṭi ciṭi , hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vajrotkṣepasūcīmukha ciṭi ciṭi hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with the invincible, unfailing noose in your hand! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amoghāpratihatapāśahaste hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , universal Amogha ! Succeed, succeed, and bring success! Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvatrāmogha sidhya sidhya sādhaya hūṁ .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the great wish-fulfilling jewel in the lotus! Jewel, jewel, the amogha jewel, the good jewel, the great jewel! The great amogha jewel that adorns all the tathāgatas! Act, act, be active! O lord of spirits that roam at night! The great lotus-armed one! The most compassionate boon giver! The great and most excellent bodhisattva who can assume any form! You hold a lotus, sit on a lotus seat, wear a lotus diadem and garland, and are adorned with many lotuses. You have a thousand arms, a thousand eyes, and various magical implements, and your thousand arms are adorned with mudrā gestures. Be victorious, be! Your body is adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays. O wearer of fine adornments, wear them, wear! Your body is adorned with jewels, gold, diamonds, beryls, emeralds, sapphires, and corals, ciri ciri ! You are a great boon-granting bodhisattva of illustrious conduct. You assume the forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara. You take on the form of the lotus lord, the lokeśvara, and the eternal lord. You wear the garb of Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, the sages, and the general Kumāra, dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhūra dhūra ! You, consecrated by all the tathāgatas, assume the form of the four great elements. Remember your samaya, O lord! Make the moon full! Ferry beings to the other shore! Train the beings! Threaten the wicked ones! Bring down the vighnas! Kill those who are stained by the three faults! Assail evil, assail, assail! Hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ , phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ! Succeed, succeed, O holder of the unfailing noose with its great wish-fulfilling jewel! Bring accomplishment! Grant me the great accomplishment of the goddess of the threefold universe! O compassionate one, be awake, be! Awaken, awaken others! Awaken them fully! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati. Please display your infinite power of magical transformation! Turū turū , you travel across the sky. Homage to you who are seen inside a grand palace! You hold a large treasure trove of merit. O great Amoghasiddhi, hūṁ hūṁ ! Give me an initiation! You confer great fame of the goddess of the threefold universe, svāhā ! Bhuva svāhā ! Bhūr bhuva svāhā ! Svāhā to Amoghavipula! Svāhā to the one who grants the accomplishment of the wish-fulfilling jewel! Svāhā to him who grants all the supreme accomplishments! Oṁ , majestic lord, lord of the world, great lord, you are a great wish-fulfilling jewel! O great Amoghasiddhi! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Reading nisā ° as niśā ° (“night”); however, this translation is dubious.

It is not clear who exactly the epithets “lotus lord,” “lord of the world” ( lokeśvara ), and “eternal lord” refer to. Or perhaps they all should be understood as referring to one and the same “eternal lotus Lord of the World,” i.e., Avalokiteśvara?

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , I salute you, O blazing fire, blazing brightly with large flames and a halo of light. You are the omniscient fire of sacrificial oblations, burning hot with smoke and hissing sounds; the flames are your face. As hot and bright as a forest fire or lightning, your main function is to consume oblations. You are the great energy, the great victory, the great power, and the destructive ability of all gods and yakṣas. Burning everything, you freely expand through space in cloud-like swirls. You are universally worshiped and honored as a fearless form of the divine. You are a bringer of winds and the oblation-eating god, Hutāśana. When there is darkness, you dispel it by radiating light. You have the fragrance of beautyberry and are born from the tastes of the best of fruits and food. Beloved, you are subtle, very sharp, and a reviver of the dead. Ashes for flowers and ashes for clothing, ashes are useful—they are always used to cover. You arise within the billows of smoke. Accomplished in cooking, you bring out the best of flavors. You run everywhere, wiping out everything. Once you touch and sting, you don’t want to let go. Among the gods of the thirty-two abodes, you are the chief god of fire. You give vitality and strength to those without appetite. You are a great fire priest, the fearless god of gods, always the most noble. Swiftly make the rites truly successful! Oṁ , burn, burn! Remain! Huru , huru the samaya! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Hutāśana, another name of Agni, the god of fire, simply means “oblation eater.” It is repeated twice in the text, once as the name and once meant literally, though it could also be an instance of dittography.
Callicarpa macrophylla .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O greatly compassionate! Viri viri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O supremely compassionate! Siri siri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O great one with the lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O great pure being! Come, come! Awaken, awaken! Cleanse, cleanse! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru , you of great tenacity! Cala cala , sañcala sañcala , vicala vicala , eṭaṭa eṭaṭa , bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru , come, come, O greatly compassionate! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati, wear, wear, sara sara , cara cara , hara hara ! Hā hā hā hā ! Hī hī hī hī ! Hū hū hū hū ! You wear the garb of Oṁkāra Brahmā, wear, wear, dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , tara tara , sara sara , para para , cara cara , vara vara ! Your body is adorned with hundreds of thousands of beautiful rays of light! Blaze, blaze, heat up, heat up! O lord whose feet are worshiped by Soma, Āditya, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, Brahmā, Indra, and the hosts of ṛṣis and gods, suru suru , curu curu , puru puru , muru muru ! You are the leader of sages and gods such as Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, and Dhanada! You wear many garbs, wear, wear, dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara , hara hara , mara mara , vara vara ! You, the great boon-granting lokeśvara lord with panoptic vision, muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya , liberate, liberate! Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, protect me, protect me and all beings from all dangers, misfortunes, and disasters, and from all the grahas and diseases! You deliver from all killings, imprisonment, abuses by the kings, thieves, bandits, fires, floods, poisons, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , cara cara ! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Tama tama , dama dama , sama sama , masa masa ! You are the great being who dispels darkness and grants the fulfillment of the six perfections! Mili mili , taṭa taṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu , ṭhiṭhi ṭhiṭhi , ṭhuṭhu ṭhuṭhu ! You who wear a sash made from the skin of black antelope, come, come! You who crush Īśvara, Maheśvara, and the hordes of the great bhūtas, act, act, para para , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You, greatly compassionate, abide in the pure sphere! You wear a white sacred thread, a jewel diadem, and a rosary! Your head is crowned with the omniscient one, and the extraordinary palms of your hands are like lotuses! Being unshakeable, you produce meditative absorption, one-pointed concentration, and liberation! You bring the mindstreams of many beings to maturity. Being very compassionate, you purify all the karmic obscurations! You save from all diseases, you fulfill all hopes, and you bring comfort to all beings! Homage be to you! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Reading saṃvicala as vicala following the Tib.
In the Tib. transliteration, the long vowels alternate with the short ha hā ha hā hi hī hi hī hu hū hu hū .

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , cara cara , curu curu , O most compassionate! Ciri ciri , biri biri , O great one with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kulu kulu , you of great tenacity! Cara cara , cara cara , O Lord of the creatures of the night! Come, come! Grant accomplishment, grant! Awaken, awaken! Cleanse, cleanse! Kiṇi kiṇi , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru , O wearer of the garb of the great Paśupati! Hā hā , hī hī , hū hū , O wearer of the garb of Oṁkāra Brahmā! Sara sara , vara vara , you with the body adorned with hundreds of thousands of beautiful rays of light! Blaze, blaze, heat up, heat up, O Lord whose feet are worshiped by Soma, Āditya, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, Brahmā, Indra, and the hosts of ṛṣis and gods! Suru suru , muru muru , O leader of sages and gods such as Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Viṣṇu, Vāsava, and Dhanada! You wear many garbs! Wear, wear! You, the great boon-granting lokeśvara lord with panoptic vision! Muya muya , save, save, O savior from killings, imprisonment, beatings, abuses by kings, bandits, fires, floods, poison, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , O teacher of the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Tame, tame! Pacify, pacify, O great pacifier and remover of the darkness of ignorance! Mili mili , O wearer of a sash made from the skin of black antelope! Come, come! Maṭa maṭa , O compassionate one who abides in the pure realm! You wear a white sacred thread, a jewel diadem, and a rosary! Your head is crowned with the omniscient one, and your hands are cupped! You, the unshakeable one, produce meditative absorption, one-pointed concentration, and liberation! You help accomplish the six perfections and bring the mindstreams of many beings to maturity! You crush all the wicked ones, including all māras! You grant every accomplishment and fulfill every hope! Please consecrate me, O Blessed Amogharāja! Grant me the empowerment of all the tathāgatas! Hūṁ phaṭ ! Homage be to you! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: In the Tib., the short and long vowels alternate: “ ha hā hi hī hu hū .”

Skt. oṁ cara cara curu curu mahākāruṇikaḥ | ciri ciri biri biri mahāpadmahastaḥ | kala kala kulu kulu mahāsthāmaprāptaḥ | cara cara cara cara niśācareśvaraḥ | ehy ehi sidhya sidhya budhya budhya dhāva dhāva kiṇi kiṇi paramaśuddhasattvaḥ | kara kara kiri kiri kuru kuru mahā paśupati veṣadharaḥ | hā hā hī hī hū hū oṁkārabrahmaveṣadharaḥ | sara sara vara vara vararaśmiśatasahasrapratimaṇḍitaśarīraḥ | jvala jvala tapa tapa bhagavān somāditya yama varuṇa kubera brahmendra ṛṣi gaṇa deva gaṇābhyarcitacaraṇaḥ | suru suru muru muru sanatkumāra rudra viṣṇu vāsavadhanada deva ṛṣi nāyakaḥ • bahuvividhaveṣadharaḥ | dhara dhara samantāvalokavilokitaḥ • lokeśvara maheśvaraḥ | muya muya muñca muñca vadhabandhanatāḍanarājataskarāgnyudakaviṣaśastraparimocakaḥ | kaṇa kaṇa bala bodhyaṅgacaturāryasatyasamprakāśakaḥ | tama tama śama śama mahā•avidyāndhakārapraśamanaḥ | mili mili • eṇeyacarmaparikaraḥ | ehy ehi maṭa maṭa viśuddhaviṣayanivāsinaḥ | mahākāruṇikaśvetayajñopavītaratnamakuṭamālādharaḥ sarvajñaśirasikṛtakarapuṭa dhyāna samādhi vimokṣyāprakampyaḥ ṣaṭpāramitāparipūrakaḥ | bahusattvasantatiparipācakaḥ | sarvamārādisarvaduṣṭapramardakaḥ | sarvasiddhyāśāparipūrakaḥ | abhiṣiñcya sarvatathāgatābhiṣekair bhagavān amogha rājaḥ | hūṁ phaṭ | namo ’stu te svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Come, come, O Lord ! You, with the lotus in your hand, whose fingers form the boon-granting gesture! You, with the lotus-like arm, who wear the garb of the great Paśupati! Please be kind and arrive soon! You move with great speed, adorned with light rays! Laugh, laugh, O pure amogha being! Move, move! Proceed, proceed! Come, come, O Blessed Avalokiteśvara! Accept these fragrant flowers I have gathered! Svāhā to you, Unfailing Accomplishment through the truth of the Three Jewels!
criticalNotes: Padmabhuja could also mean “[you with] the lotus [around] your arm,” as seen in some iconographic forms of both Avalokiteśvara and Amoghapāśa.

“Unfailing Accomplishment” ( Amoghasiddhi ) is one of the epithets of Amoghapāśa and his forms. Here it is rendered in English to better convey the implied logic of this statement, namely that his accomplishment is unfailing because of the ontological truth of the Three Jewels and all it entails.

mantras.sanskritIast: You are delightfully adorned with fragrant garlands and beautified by the crescent moon on your head. Please accept these fragrances, flowers, and scented unguents from me! Vara vara , O boon granter! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: It is difficult to replicate in English the alliteration of the preceding two instances of vara being used as verbs and vara meaning “boon” as it does in this case.
Skt. sarvagandhamālyavibhūṣitapriye candrārdhaśirasipriye gandha puṣpānulepana[ṃ] †sā† mama pratīccha | vara vara varadāyaka svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Hili hili , mili mili , O great luminous and immaculate one who wears the garb of Brahmā and grants the boon of kind disposition! Turu turu , O one adorned with colorful garlands! Hara hara , mara mara , turu turu ! Take delight in the essence of Amogha ! Accept from me these fine flowers! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. hili hili mili mili mahāprabhāsvaravimale brahmaveṣadhare sumativarade | turu turu vicitramālyavibhūṣite | hara hara mara mara turu turu | amogha hṛdayapramodaṃ kuru | pratīccha mama puṣpavare svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: You grant the boons of the great bodhisattva. Remember, remember the samaya of the Blessed One! You obtain comfort from all tathāgatas. Look at the Blessed One! You watch over all beings. You are endowed with the amogha quality. You with the noose in your hand, you are accomplished, you are! You have accomplished your vow. By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha, bhuru bhuru ! Svāhā to the protector of the true samaya!
criticalNotes: Because of its mainly female endings, this vidyā mantra seems to be addressing a female vidyā deity.
In place of “you have accomplished your vow” ( siddhavrate ), the Tib. reads, “you are an accomplished boon granter” ( siddhavarade ).

mantras.sanskritIast: Dhure dhure , vajra dhara padmajaye vigatavāvarade ! Vega vega , dhuṭa dhuṭa , sarvabījapriye ! By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha, mili mili ! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: While the words vajra dhara , padmajaye , and varade could be translated as “vajra holder,” “lotus victory,” and “boon granter,” respectively, the meaning of vigatavā is not immediately obvious; it could be a Buddhist Hybrid Sanskrit form of the past active participle meaning “you who (had) departed.” The Tibetan variant vigatā , which presumes that the deity is female, could have a similar meaning.
This section of the mantra has been left untranslated because the meaning is unclear.

mantras.sanskritIast: O Lord with the indestructible wisdom-body of a tathāgata! Āhara āhara ! You on a lotus seat, with lotus-like arms, a white body, and white arms, adorned with white garlands! Dhuma dhuma ! Burn! By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: The form āhara is probably the second person imperative singular of ā + √ hṛ , meaning either “to bring” or “to deliver/convey” (the latter usually being the function of fire). It is not clear who is addressed here.
The form dhuma , related in meaning to smoke, seems to be referring to the burning lamps.

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Hero! Hero Padmapāṇi! Come, come! You have accomplished the amogha nature. You are impelled by the rays of light in the sky of all the tathāgatas. You purify all the vidyā holders. You have accomplished the blazing amogha light. Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vīra vīra padmapāṇi | āgama • āgama • amogha tattvasiddhe sarva tathāgata gaganaraśmisaṃcodite sarvavidyādharaviśodhane • amoghajvalasiddhe svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Dhume dhume ! O dhudhuma lotus! You are pure like a lotus, pure and immaculate with a golden hue. You are the purity of pure essences, the purity within the pure sphere! O lotus-limbed one! You clothe beings in clothes. Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Again, the feminine endings indicate that it is the vidyā of clothing herself who is being addressed.
Skt. dhume dhume dhudhume padme padmanirbhāsa śuddha śuddha kāñcanaprabhāsavimale | śuddhasārāgryo śuci śuci gocaraśuddhe padmāṅgavati prāvaraṇi svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: O bringer of peace, please pacify! Bring me peace, O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection and well-being! You bring me joy. Please purify all my wrongdoings! You are peaceful, pure, auspicious, and immaculate! You win through peace; yours is the perfect victory! O Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, move, move! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: “O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection” is omitted in the Tib. transliteration.
Skt. śāme śāmaya śānti me śrī tribhuvanadevy ārakṣasvastyayanaṃ kuru | sāntoṣi me sarvapāpaṃ śāntaśuddhakalyāṇaviraje śāntivijaye jayasiddhe | bhagavann āryāvalokiteśvara sara sara svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: O divine water, distinguished by the presence of the nāgas! O carrier of water! You purge the water of serpent-demons and remove the danger of rough waters. You are the water in the lotus pond, pure as lotuses! You are the water for the hands. Please purify the body! Vara vara , O water! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: “The danger of rough waters” ( jalasaṃkṣobhabhaya ) is the Tib. reading. The mantra quoted in the note has been emended accordingly. The Skt. reads jalasaṃkhyābhaya , which is difficult to interpret.
Skt. nāga prakarṣaṇe divyajale jalavāhe | jalasaṃkṣobhabhayaṃ yan nāga jalasaṃśodhani padmasare padmaviśuddhe pāṇijale saṃśodhaya • ātman | vara vara salile svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: O goddess of the entire world! You purify the world and satiate it, O pure, most eminent one! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. sakalabhuvane bhuvanaviśodhani santarpya pravara viśuddhe svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: You are worshiped by all gods and asuras! You fill up the space! You are perfumed with every fragrance! You possess the purity of the sky! You are the light of liberation! O victorious goddess of victory, the provider of discarded garlands! You purify the scent of flowers in the discarded garlands; purify it! You are the purity of all the tathāgatas, the lotus-like purifier! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Again, the feminine endings indicate that it is the vidyā herself who is addressed in this mantra.

The translation “You are perfumed with every fragrance” is of sarvagandhāvavāsite , conjectured based on the Skt. ( sarvagandhānasite ) and Tib. ( samagandhāvabhāsite ) readings. The mantra quoted in the note has been emended accordingly.

mantras.sanskritIast: You possess the ability to contain and the ability to arrest. Arrest it, arrest, O semen purifier! Marked with a white garland, you are the purifier of semen. O purity of the semen! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: The epithet “marked with a white garland” ( śuklamāliliṅginī ) entails a pun because of the double meaning of the Sanskrit words. Śukla (“white”) can be a variant spelling of śukra (“semen”), and liṅga , apart from “mark,” can mean “penis.” Because of its feminine ending, the epithet, derived thus from the three-word phrase (“semen-garlanded penis”), seems to be addressing the vidyā of arresting the semen, asking her to arrest the semen.
Skt. dharaṇiṃdhare dharaṇibandhe bandha bandha śukraviśodhani śuklamāliliṅgini śukraviśodhani śukravimale svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: O blazing blaze! O immaculate blaze! You are like the sun, powerful and pure! Be victorious, O wearer of lotus garlands! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Again, the feminine endings indicate that it is the vidyā herself who is addressed in this mantra.
Skt. jvalajvale vimalo jvale prabhāvaviraje sūryavati | jaya padmamālādhare svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Water, water! Rich in water! Source of water! The swimming place of nāgas! O divine water! Mili mili ! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. jale jale jalavati jalaprabhāvani nāga sraviṇi divyavāriṇi mili mili svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: O captivating one of yellow color! Yellow like piṅgala ! Hiri hiri ! Stir, O Lord, stir and remain! Protect me, protect! By the truth of the Buddha, Dharma, and Saṅgha, svāhā !
criticalNotes: The Sanskrit uses here a word with a double meaning: hāriṇi (vocative, feminine form) means “captivating” and can also mean “yellow,” referring to the color of the kuśa-grass straw used for making the ritual seat. This word is repeated twice.
Piṅgala can mean a number of yellow things, including yellow orpiment.

mantras.sanskritIast: Come, Blessed Padmasundarī! Great vidyā goddess! Move, move, O swift Padmasundarī! Huru huru ! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. ehi bhagavati padmasundari mahā vidyā devati | cala cala padmasundari vegavati | huru huru svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: You possess the majestic power of the amogha essence! You pacify all vighnas! Bring them over! Bring them together! You sit on a lotus seat, your lotus arms adorned with jewels and gold! Carry across, carry across! Deliver from evil! You are the victorious amogha essence! O three-eyed one with hands that grant boons! Remember, remember the samaya of all the blessed tathāgatas! Wear, wear, bhuru bhuru , O wearer of the garb of Brahmā whose body is adorned! You are the great remover of fear! Look at and watch over them, you who watch over all beings! Vara vara , O boon giver! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Again, this part of the mantra addresses a female vidyā. The gender changes from “wearer of the garb of Brahmā,” which is masculine.
Grant boons, or perhaps display the boon-granting mudrā.

mantras.sanskritIast: Para para , mara mara , bind, bind everywhere, you with the unfailing noose in your hand! Remain, remain! By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. para para mara mara bandha bandha samantena • amogha pāśahaste | tiṣṭha tiṣṭha | buddha dharma saṅgha satyena svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: You bind the directions, O unfailing and perfect one! Muru muru , suru suru , turu turu ! O destroyer of all vighnas, adorned with lotus ponds! By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha, please bind, O unconquerable giver of boons! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. diśabandhani • amoghe • apratihate muru muru suru suru turu turu sarva vighna vināśanapadmasarabhūṣite | buddha dharma saṅgha satyena bandha • ajinavarade svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Hili hili , mili mili , siri siri , piri piri , move, move, move fast, O driver of the best of chariots! Dara dara , go, go to the abode of Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara! Hurry, hurry, O bearer of the amogha lotus! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. hili hili mili mili siri siri piri piri cara cara pracara vimānadhara | dara dara gaccha gaccha bhagavān āryāvalokiteśvara svabhavanam | turu turu amogha padme svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , lotus, lotus! Your arms are adorned with the lotuses you hold. O wearer of the garb of Brahmā, wear, wear! You have a bright diadem on your head, and your body is adorned with jewelry, gold, diamonds, and beryl stones. Please ferry us, ferry, O Blessed Lord and Lady! Help us cross to the other shore! Dhūru dhūru , you with the noose of Amogha in your hand! Vara vara , O boon giver with panoptic vision! O great bodhisattva who grants boons, white as lotus and sitting on a lotus seat! Blaze, blaze! You are consecrated by all the tathāgatas. O most compassionate one! O strength, strength, great strength! O swift one! With your face contorted in anger and fangs protruding, you possess great fiery energy. Yours is a vast knowledge, O boon giver! Yours is great compassion, O wearer of the garb of the great Paśupati! Move, move! You are the best means of accumulating merit. Endowed with the meditative concentration and samādhi of a sugata, you can see everywhere! You are Īśvara and Maheśvara, the tamer of wicked beings! You are the fierce tamer of the deities of dissolution, the great wearer of the garb of the lord of wrath! Sama sama ! You possess great tenacity, and your splendor exceeds that of the moon and the sun. Mala mala , you purify all impurities. You are the wearer of the great garb of Maheśvara surrounded by multitudes of gaṇas and ṛṣis. Your topknots are adorned with the victorious Amitābha, your right head with the moon. Crush them, crush, O destroyer of the hordes of all yakṣas, rākṣasas, and bhūtas. Ferry across, ferry across, you who are adorned with a multitude of stars and garlanded with constellations! O you whose thoughts are filled with supreme love, who has great compassion, and who is the bringer of ruin upon all the vighnas. Para para , you who comprise the full maṇḍala! Happy and at ease, you fully accomplish the six perfections. Mili mili ! O wearer of the tunic made from the skin of a black antelope and an upper garment made of a tiger skin, wear, wear! Your gaze, O three-eyed one, is that of all the tathāgatas. You carry a trident, a blazing vajra, and an unfailing noose in your hand. You assume the forms of Yama, Varuṇa, and Kubera, and also of the nāga kings. Your body is immaculately pure, and you pacify all nonvirtue, purify all obscurations, and remove all evil. You enthrall the three worlds and purify all beings. Blessed by all tathāgatas, you grant the bodhisattva boon of awakening. Oṁ , O pure one adorned with lotuses! Dhiri dhiri ! Watch over me! Sama sama , accomplish all my activities! You are the perfect essence of Amoghapāśa. You live in a secret dwelling, O boon giver, hūṁ phaṭ ! Homage to you, svāhā !
criticalNotes: The Sanskrit could also be translated as “You tame Īśvara and Maheśvara.”
As indicated in the painting instructions that follow, this form of the deity has three heads, with each of the three topknots adorned with Amitābha.

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O lotus-eyed lotus lady sitting on a lotus seat and holding a lotus! O Padmāvatī, fond of lotuses, lotus white with a lotus glow, seated upon a lotus seat! Fond of Avalokiteśvara, you grant boons and facilitate boons. Please be kind and inspire with kindness! Act, act, O bestower of the boons of Noble Avalokiteśvara! Huru huru , O fine bodied one! Move, move, O lotus lover adorned with flowers! Owner of fine chariots, carry, carry! Bring together! Remember your samaya! You are the same as Noble Avalokiteśvara, O goddess established in the truth who grants amogha boons! Hūṁ ! Homage be to you, svāhā !
criticalNotes: The Skt. pratiṣṭhita does not indicate whether she is sitting or standing.

Skt. oṁ padmini padmanetri padmāśe padmadhare padmavati padmapriye padmagaurī padmaprabhe padmāsanapratiṣṭhite • avalokita priye varade varadāyini | prasīda prasādaya kuru kuru • āryāvalokitavarade | huru huru varāṅgini | cala cala puṣpavibhūṣitapadmapriye vicitravimānadhare | bhara bhara sambhara smara samayam āryāvalokite same satyādhiṣṭhitadevi • amogha pāśavarade | hūṁ | namo ’stu te svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , blessed mother-eyed one! Vara vara , O giver of boons of Avalokiteśvara! Ooze, O milk giver! Mother, mother, you bring wide renown! You have exquisite curves and hold the unfailing noose in your hand, svāhā !
criticalNotes: There is a play on words here, as the Sanskrit word for boon, vara , is homonymous with the preceding vara .
Skt. oṁ bhagavati māturyanetrī | vara vara • avalokita varade | kṣīriṇi sravatu | amba • amba vipulakīrtikare pravarabhuje • amogha pāśahaste svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , fragrant lake where lotuses are seen, reservoir of amogha water, gathering of lotuses! Save us, save, O joyful one! Hūṁ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ puṣpavilokite gandhasare amogha jalasambharaṇi padmasambhari tara tara mudite hūṁ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O boon-granting lotus lady, the heart essence of Amoghapāśa, blaze, blaze! You, with your lotus arms extended forth! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha pāśahṛdayapadmini varade jvala jvala prasāritapadmabhuje svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O lady with a lotus gaze and a perfect body! Turu turu ! Hūṁ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ avalokita padmini varāṅgini turu turu hūṁ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you are the gaze of all the tathāgatas, the amogha essence! Move, move, O most compassionate one! Hūṁ ! Consecrate me! The holder of the unfailing noose, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvatathāgatāvalokita amogha hṛdaya cara cara mahākāruṇika sādhaya hūṁ | abhiśiñcaya • amogha pāśahaste svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O great torrent of the gaze of all the tathāgatas! Conquer, conquer! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarvatathāgatāvalokitamahaugha jaya jaya svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O wrathful one with the amogha lotus noose! Pull them in and make them enter! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati and of Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Brahmā. You are the amogha essence! Hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ , phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā to you, the samaya of the lotus family!
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha padmapāśa krodha ākarṣaya praveśaya | mahā paśupati yama varuṇa kubera brahmaveṣadharaḥ | amogha hṛdayapadmakulasamayāya hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the heart essence of the noose gaze of all the tathāgatas, blaze, blaze! Born from the dharmadhātu, move, move! O great one with lotus arms, carry, carry! O bearer of the great noose, hold captive, hold! With your body adorned with hundreds of thousands of beautiful light rays, pass through, pass! You are endowed with the great fiery energy, bear, bear! You fulfill the six perfections, kala kala ! O wearer of the great garb of Brahmā, mala mala ! You remove all evil, obscurations, and nonvirtue, dhuru dhuru ! O pure bodhisattva being, bhuru bhuru ! O beloved great being! You are revered by Yama, Varuṇa, and Kubera, huru huru ! You are revered and adored by the gods Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśvara, Kumāra, Nandikeśvara, Īśvara, and Maheśvara! You wear various jewels in your diadem, which is crowned with the victorious Amitābha! Your body is adorned with divine jewels, gold, diamonds, beryls, emeralds, rubies, sapphires, and divine pearls! You are invested with the white sacred thread! Your topknot is adorned with a diadem and a new moon! You hold a lotus, sit on a lotus seat, and have lotus arms. O three-eyed one with a trident and a noose! You are consecrated by all the tathāgatas, sara sara ! You pacify all evil! O most compassionate one, turu turu ! You grant every boon! O bodhi, bodhi! Yours is the gaze of all the tathāgatas, the gaze that is the essence of awakening! O great lord of the world, holder of the wish-fulfilling jewel, one that assumes all forms! With a sweet expression on your face and great compassion, maintain your wakefulness, maintain! Awaken them, awaken! O Blessed Lord , you are the essence of all the tathāgatas’ enlightenment ( āloka ). You possess great merit and great brilliance! You bring the most excellent accomplishment! You remove every disease! Loving care for all beings is your highest commitment! You release them from all suffering, O most compassionate one! Homage be to you, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Reading (on the authority of the Tib.) bhaga ˚ as bhara . The Sanskrit text of the mantra quoted in the note has been emended accordingly.
The Sanskrit manuscript has sarvavyādhihara (“O remover of all diseases!”) repeated twice. The text of the mantra quoted in the note has been emended.

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Padmapāṇi! Hold, hold, O lotus-armed one! Blaze, blaze, O oblation eater! Flicker, flicker! Your arms grant liberation. Burn, burn all the impurities! Your hand displays the amogha boon-granting gesture, hūṁ hūṁ ! Burn all evil! Pacify, O pacifier who saves the world! O boon granter, immersed in light, make haste, make haste! Your amogha accomplishment is awesome. Oṁ bhūr bhuva ! Homage to you! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Oṁ bhūr bhuva (also oṁ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ ) is the famous Gāyatrī mantra found in the Ṛgveda (3.62.10).

Skt. oṁ padmapāṇi dhara dhara padmabhuje jvala jvala hutāśane bhuru bhuru vimokṣabhuje daha daha sarvamalān amogha pāṇivarade hūṁ hūṁ | nirdaha pāpān śama śamani lokottāraṇi samantaraśmivarade turu turu pravara· amogha siddhiḥ | oṁ bhūr bhuva namo ’stu te svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O great lotus maṇḍala of the amogha gaze! You are honored by all the bodhisattvas. Keep it, keep! You can see everywhere, O amogha wearer of the great garb of Brahmā! Wear it, wear, O most compassionate one! Awaken them, awaken, O great awakener! O awakening, awakening! O lotus awakener, you pacify all the darkness produced by evil. You block all unhappy destinies, O most compassionate one! You take on many appearances and yet retain the essence of a tathāgata. Huru huru , O amogha essence! Turu turu , O Amoghapāśa with a noose in your hand! Muru muru , you whose arms grant liberation! Diminish them, diminish, O purifier of all obscurations! You fully embody every tathāgata—carry them in you, carry! Gaze, one with lotus-like arms, adorned with jewels and gold! Tame, tame those difficult to tame, O great bodhisattva! O most compassionate granter of boons, honored by all gods and praised by all ṛṣis! You are radiant with light brighter than a hundred thousand suns and moons. You wear the great garb of Paśupati, O supremely pure being! You are the lokeśvara of compassionate gazing, a great lord, the supremely compassionate lord of the maṇḍala, the fully awakened one! O great lord with a lotus in your hand, the great lord of vidyādhara s! Be steadfast, be steadfast, O great steadfast being! You are the most compassionate upholder of great maṇḍalas of liberation. You keep the samaya of the secret seat of all the tathāgatas. You possess great energy and strength. You wear a jeweled diadem upon your head crowned with Amitābha. Wear it, wear! O lord with panoptic vision! O great lord who carries the noose! O supreme, supreme, supremely compassionate being who gazes with great compassion and delivers all beings from suffering! O accomplishment, accomplishment, you fulfill all hopes! O great granter of boons, homage to you! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: This phrase, which addresses Amoghapāśa, is a somewhat arbitrary rendering of the Sanskrit compound amoghāvalokitamahā maṇḍala padma .
“Accomplishment” ( siddhi ) in the vocative case could be a short form of the epithet amoghasiddhi (“unfailing accomplishment”), sometimes regarded as a deity in his own right.

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , hero, hero! The omnifarious form of the great maṇḍala! You are the fulfiller of the six perfections, honored by all the bodhisattvas! O supreme sustainer of the vast state of liberation! Your great gaze is your noose, O blazing light of the unfailing noose! Your gaze is a great blaze! You hold the great jeweled lamp that shines its light everywhere. Blaze, blaze! You hold the great noose of profound liberation! You bring the power and the means to attain awakening! Oṁ , your form is infinite, O great Amoghapāśa! Hūṁ hūṁ , phaṭ phaṭ ! You gaze at all beings. O generous granter of boons, homage be to you! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vīra vīra mahā maṇḍala viśvarūpa ṣaṭpāramitāparipūrakaḥ sarva bodhisattva namaskṛtaḥ paramavipulavimokṣadharaḥ · mahāpāśavilokita · amogha pāśajvalita mahājvālāvalokita mahāmaṇidīptadharaḥ samantāvabhāsitaḥ · jvala jvala mahāgambhīravimokṣapāśadharaḥ · bala bodhyaṅgākarṣaka | oṁ brahmarūpamahāmoghapāśa hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ | sarvasattvavilokita varaprada namo ’stu te svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , awaken them, awaken, awaken, O most compassionate one! Ferry, ferry! Take beings across the great ocean to the other shore! O strong-armed one, look on with compassion! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ vibudhya vibudhya vibudhya mahākāruṇika | tara tara tāraya mahārṇavapāram | mahābhuja vilokaya hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghapāśa, please fulfill the great perfection of generosity, hūṁ ! Burst, burst the clouds of offerings! Bring to all beings various wonderful enjoyments! Set in motion the great generosity of all tathāgatas! Ferry, ferry! Take the beings across the ocean of suffering, O great being with a lotus in your hand! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha pāśa mahādānapāramitām paripūraya hūṁ dara dara vividhavicitraiḥ sarvasattvopabhogasarva tathāgata mahādāna pūjā meghaiḥ pravartaya | tara tara tarāya mahāpadmapāṇi hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghaśīla, accumulate, accumulate! Hold on, hold on, O great pure being! Your hands are adorned with lotuses; hold them, hold! You can see everywhere, hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha śīla sambhara sambhara bhara bhara mahāśuddhasattva padmavibhuṣitabhuja dhara dhara samantāvalokita hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghavilokita who has great energy, vara vara ! Steady energy and great strength! Strength, strength, the great aid to awakening, you are a powerful awakener, hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ mahāvīryāmoghavilokite vara vara dṛḍhavīrya mahā bala bala bala mahābodhyaṅga bala bodhyani hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghakṣānti, you possess the forbearance of all the bodhisattvas! Be forbearing, be forbearing! With your great kindness and compassion, you love all beings as your children. O most compassionate being, you have forbearance for all beings! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Reading kṣaṇa kṣaṇa as kṣama kṣama . The meaning of kṣaṇa (“a free state pregnant with opportunities”), however, could also be fitted into the context of this dhāraṇī.
Skt. oṁ amogha kṣānti sarvabodhisattvakṣamiṇa kṣaṇa kṣaṇa mahāmaitrīkaruṇāsattvavatsala mahākāruṇika sarvasattvakṣamiṇa hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you possess the great amogha compassion, meditative concentration, and samādhi of all the tathāgatas! You liberate everyone, O unshakable one! Curu curu ! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ sarva tathāgata mahāmoghakaruṇādhyānasamādhiḥ sarvavimokṣa prakampya curu curu hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the great splendor of amogha wisdom! Your intellect bursts forth in all directions. May it expand, may it expand! Your intellect is all-encompassing. Look on, Lord , with your eye of wisdom’s gaze! With your hand displaying the boon-granting gesture, you grant the boon of great wisdom, while in your other hand you hold the lotus of great wisdom. Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha mahāprajñāvabhāsa samantasphuraṇabuddhiḥ prasara prasara samantabuddhiḥ | avalokaya bhagavan prajñāvalokitacakṣuṣā mahāprajñāvaradapāṇi mahāprajñāpadmadhāriṇa bhuje hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you are a pure being, a wondrous amogha maṇḍala of liberation! Support, support! Be steadfast, be steadfast! You hold a marvelous great lotus and wear Amitābha as your crest jewel! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vimokṣa maṇḍala mahādbhutavimale dhara dhara dhiri dhiri mahādbhutakamala-m- amitābha makuṭadharaṃ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you with lotus-like arms! Please amogha-purify the various beautiful trees, tree vines, vegetables, leaves, flowers, fruits, sprouts, uplands, rivers, ponds, lotus lakes, springs, water reservoirs, and magnificent waterfalls! Purify the area, sama sama , all around! Mala mala , stainless and immaculate! Kissed by an immaculate lotus! Purify, purify the polluted waters, O supremely pure great being! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā ! Homage to the lord of the three worlds! Hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: In the Sanskrit text, sama sama is added alliteratively before samantena (“all around”). This alliteration would be difficult to replicate in English.
In the Sanskrit text, mala mala is added alliteratively before vimala nirmala . This alliteration would be difficult to replicate in English.

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , amogha stainless, free from the three stains, free from dirt, immaculately pure, divinely pure! You are invoked to remove all stains. O great, boon-granting, eminently pure bodhisattva! Your pure body is like a great jewel. You are a jewel, a purifying jewel! A great, pure, wish-fulfilling amogha jewel! You are pure at heart, and pure in the body that is like a great gem. Huru huru ! Your hands are most excellent. You display the great boon-granting gesture with your hand. Turu turu ! You love sentient beings as your own children. Cleanse me of all my evil, O immaculately pure being! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha · amale ’trimale vimale nirmale divyapariśuddhe sarvamalopakarṣite mahābodhisattvavarade pravarapariśuddhe mahāmaṇiratnakāyapariśuddhe maṇi maṇiśodhani mahāmoghacintāmaṇiśuddhe hṛdayaśuddhe kāyanirmalamahāmaṇipariśuddhe huru huru pravarapāṇi mahābhujavarade turu turu mahāsattvavatsale pariśodhaya māṃ sarvapāpā suviśuddhamale svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , pure Amoghapadma, expand! You face all the quarters, svāhā !
criticalNotes: The literal meaning of amoghapadma (“amogha lotus”) is significant here, as, metaphorically, it is perhaps the lotus that is meant to expand in all directions.
Skt. oṁ amogha padmavimale prasara samantamukhe svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you possess various amogha forms and colors; you bring various scents and flavors; you hold various implements in your hands, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vividharūpavicitragandharasabharapravarabhuje svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you bind the full circle of the maṇḍala with the noose. Hūṁ !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha samantaparimaṇḍalapāśabaddhe hūṁ ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , create a great amogha-boundary encompassing in the ten directions! Dhuru dhuru , hūṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha samantadaśadigmahāsīmā[ṃ] bandhaya dhuru dhuru hūṁ phaṭ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you hold in your hand the protecting, unfailing noose. Bhuru bhuru , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha rakṣaṇapāśahaste bhuru bhuru svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you carry the amogha jewel in your topknot. Huru huru ! You bind the nāgas with the noose! Hūṁ , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha cūḍāmaṇi huru huru nāga pāśabaddhe hūṁ svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you create amogha protection everywhere with the great noose. Bhuru bhuru , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha rakṣā samantena mahāpāśe bhuru bhuru svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , pure amogha water! Suru suru , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha jalavimale suru suru svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the drop of amogha nectar! Act, act! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha ·amṛta bindu cara cara svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , O divine amogha clothes! Curu curu , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha vidyāvastre curu curu svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , you provide the best armor with your amogha arms. Ciri ciri , svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha bhujakavacavarade ciri ciri svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , please extend your great amogha arms far and wide! Svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha brahmabhuje paryantena prasara svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghapadma with a jewel upon your topknot, consecrate me! Grant me the empowerment of all the tathāgatas! O jewel, jewel, svāhā !
criticalNotes: Skt. oṁ amogha cūḍāmaṇipadme · abhiṣiñcaya mama sarvatathāgatābhiṣekair maṇi maṇi svāhā ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , Amoghapadma, you are the supporting earth! Support, support! You are the earth seat, hūṁ !
criticalNotes: The mantra has been emended here (on the authority of the Tib.) from dhare dhara to dhara dhara .
Skt. oṁ amogha padma vasundhare dhara dhara dharaṇi maṇḍe hūṁ ||

mantras.sanskritIast: Oṁ , the universal amogha posture! Heaven and earth, svāhā !
